key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥10% and notably more frequent than placebo) are orthostatic hypotension, bradycardia, hypotension, dizziness, somnolence, sedation, and dry mouth. In the label's two-dose study (assigned daily doses lofexidine 2.16 mg/day N=229, 2.88 mg/day N=222, vs placebo N=151), rates were: orthostatic hypotension 29/42/5%, bradycardia 24/32/5%, hypotension 30/30/1%, dizziness 19/23/3%. Serious risks include hypotension, bradycardia, syncope and QT prolongation.
